HOW TO PLAY

15m / 20 actions. RIGHT first, then alternate LEFT and RIGHT. Start after the countdown; the first correct tap starts the timer. Keep your rhythm to earn PERFECT or GOOD. TOO EARLY and WRONG HAND add time penalties.
